review_reason: The question attaches a coach to football as a whole although the Wisoon paragraph says he coached the national under-23 team. More decisively, the full context gives November 18 for the football start and December 1 for the opening ceremony, a 13-day interval, while the annotated sentence says 14 days. This internal numerical contradiction prevents a unique source-validated exact duration.
